g.title: TF_PROFILE_CATALOG
g.text: When turned off, users in this profile who are also eligible to use the Proxy feature can impersonate any active user. When turned on, users in this profile who are also eligible to use the Proxy feature can only impersonate active users included in the specified set
A set used to limit the list of users that is possible to impersonate using the proxy logon feature.
This profile is exclude from automatical assignment of default profiles.

g.title: HR_STRUCTURETYPE
g.text: Structure Type - A Structure Type define the semantics of all Structures in that type.
Name of the Structure Type. For example Legal Structure, Person to Person.
Flag indicating that the structure is managed on historical basis.
This flag enables for Structures in the same type to be overallping.
This flag indicates if the structure can have only one root.
Flag indicating if the type of relationship can indirectly end-up with a Person to Person relationship.
Database view used to access the person to Person relationships.
This flag indicates if a Structure in a specific Type is versionable, which means that you can track all historical changes without cloning the whole Structure every time.
This property determines if the type of structure allows views.
A number indicating the importance of the entity it relates to.
